name: toolcrib
description: Per-category slice of component-manifest.json's "components" array (category: Data Display), for on-demand detail without loading the full manifest. See component-manifest.json for themeSystem/zIndexScale/eventBus and cross-category data.

components.name: Accordion

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of items to render as accordion panels.

type.description: `'single'` allows only one panel open at a time. `'multiple'` allows any combination.

defaultValue.description: Value of the initially expanded panel (for `type='single'`).

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for header padding, item gap, variant, and panel animation.

components.constraints: For a long list of many items, wrap each item's `content` value in `<DeferredContent estimatedHeight={...}>` to defer off-screen ones (each item is content-sized, not flex-fill, so this is safe)
components.description: Data-driven collapsible panel group with animations

components.name: Avatar

src.description: Image URL. Falls back to `fallback` if omitted, loading, or failing to load.

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the image.

fallback.description: Content shown while `src` is missing/loading/erroring — typically initials.

fallbackDelayMs.description:
Delay in milliseconds before the fallback renders while the image is
still loading, avoiding a flash of fallback content for a fast-loading
image. Omitted by default — Radix's own `AvatarPrimitive.Fallback`
renders immediately with no artificial delay unless `delayMs` is
explicitly passed (confirmed in `@radix-ui/react-avatar`'s source:
its `canRender` state starts `true` only when `delayMs === undefined`),
so defaulting this to a nonzero value here would force every avatar
with no `src` — the common initials-only case — to sit blank for that
long before showing its fallback, for no benefit.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the avatar's shape.

components.description: User/entity avatar image with automatic initials fallback

components.name: Badge

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted, then a neutral grey.

size.description: Badge size, controlling padding and font-size.

icon.description: Icon rendered before the label text.

components.description: Small status/label pill with the same four semantic subthemes as `<Toast>`/`<DataTable rowSubtheme>`

series.description: One or more series, each with one value per `categories` entry. A single series renders ungrouped bars and no legend.

height.description: SVG height in pixels, including the axis band.

title.description: Accessible name for the chart, and its visible caption when given.

legendPosition.description: `'bottom'` (default) wraps the legend below the chart; `'side'` places it beside the chart, stacked vertically.

components.description: Grouped vertical bar chart for categorical comparisons

components.description: Breadcrumb trail built on React Aria Components, collapsing middle items into a `<DropdownMenu>` on overflow

components.name: Carousel

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

loop.description:
Whether the carousel wraps from the last slide back to the first (and
vice versa) instead of stopping at the ends.

autoplay.description: When provided, automatically advances to the next slide every `delayMs`. Omit for no autoplay.

onSlideChange.description: Change callback fired whenever the active slide changes, from drag, arrow click, dot click, or autoplay.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for arrow size, dot size/colour, and slide gap.

components.description: Swipeable slide carousel with drag/loop physics via embla-carousel-react, plus themed nav arrows and dot indicators

components.name: DataTable

id.description:
Identifier included in this instance's `datatable:sorted`/
`datatable:paginated`/`datatable:row_clicked` event bus payloads, so a
listener watching multiple tables can tell them apart. Auto-generated
if omitted (still included in payloads either way) — unlike
`Modal`/`Popup`/`Accordion`'s `id`, there's no bus-driven open/close
counterpart to target, so this exists purely for event attribution.

data.description: Array of data records to display.

columns.description: Column definitions controlling header, cell rendering, and sorting.

pagination.description:
Renders a page-at-a-time with Prev/Next controls when true (the
default). Set to false to virtualize across the *entire* sorted
dataset instead — no pagination footer, no page slicing — the
better fit once a dataset is too large to page through usefully.
`pageSize`/`pageSizeOptions` are ignored in this mode.

pageSize.description: Initial number of rows per page.

pageSizeOptions.description: Options shown in the page-size dropdown.

itemHeight.description: Height of each row in pixels (used for virtualization calculations).

containerHeight.description: Container height. `'auto'` fills available space. A number sets a fixed pixel height.

rowKey.description: Custom row key extractor for React reconciliation. Defaults to array index.

rowSubtheme.type: (record: T, index: number) => SubthemeName | Partial<SubthemeColors> | undefined
rowSubtheme.description:
Styles a row. Return either:
- One of the toolkit's four semantic subtheme names (`'error'` /
  `'success'` / `'warning'` / `'info'`) — resolved via
  `theme/subtheme.ts`'s `resolveSubtheme` into the same
  WCAG-guaranteed colors used by `subtheme` on `Button`/`Progress`/
  `Toast`. This is the common case: flagging a row (a failed job, a
  pending invoice) with the toolkit's existing semantic vocabulary
  instead of one-off colors.
- A `Partial<SubthemeColors>` slice — `{ background?, border?, color?
  }` (see `theme/subtheme.ts`) — for a custom row color the four
  presets don't cover. Only the fields you set are applied; a field
  left out falls back to that row's normal, unflagged appearance
  (default zebra background / border / text color) rather than to
  any preset. `resolveSubtheme(name)` returns this exact shape, so
  `rowSubtheme={(r) => ({ ...resolveSubtheme('warning'), border:
  myCustomBorder })}` composes a preset with a one-off override.

Either form is applied to the row's background/border and to every
cell's text color in it, and disables that row's zebra-striping so
the color stays legible. Return `undefined` for a row that shouldn't
be styled.

`index` is the row's position within the *current page* (matching
`rowKey`/`Column.render`'s `index`), not its position in the full
`data` array — it resets to `0` at the top of every page. When
`pagination` is false there's only one "page", so it's simply this
row's absolute index in the sorted dataset.

onRowClick.description:
Called when a row is clicked. Every row click also emits
`datatable:row_clicked` on the event bus regardless of whether this is
given, so an AI agent observing the bus can see row interactions even
in apps that don't wire up their own handler — this prop is for the
app's own reaction (open a detail view, select the row, etc.). Rows
only show a pointer cursor when this is provided, so the visual
affordance matches what's actually clickable.

sortKey.description:
Controlled sort key. Pass a value (a column's `key`, or `null` for
unsorted) to drive sorting from parent state — e.g. to persist it in
a URL — instead of letting `<DataTable>` manage it internally. Omit
entirely for the common uncontrolled case; `defaultSortKey` seeds
that internal state instead.

defaultSortKey.description: Initial sort key when uncontrolled (`sortKey` omitted).

sortDirection.description: Controlled sort direction. Only meaningful alongside `sortKey`.

onSortChange.description:
Called whenever sort changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled —
mirrors `datatable:sorted`'s payload shape as direct props instead
of a bus subscription. `key` is `null` when the cycle lands back on
unsorted.

page.description:
Controlled current page (1-indexed). Pass a value to drive paging
from parent state instead of letting `<DataTable>` manage it
internally. Omit for the common uncontrolled case; `defaultPage`
seeds that internal state instead. No effect when `pagination` is
false.

onPageChange.description: Called whenever the page changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

selectable.description:
Adds a checkbox selection column and a bulk-action bar. Greenfield —
there is no selection model on `<DataTable>` without this.

selectedKeys.description:
Controlled set of selected row keys (matching whatever `rowKey`
resolves to, stringified). Pass to drive selection from parent state
instead of letting `<DataTable>` manage it internally. Omit for the
common uncontrolled case; `defaultSelectedKeys` seeds that internal
state instead.

Selection persists across pages — a `Set` of keys held regardless of
`page`, not reset per page — since "select N of M rows, filtered
across pages" is the realistic case a bulk-action bar exists for.
This is correct out of the box only with a real, stable `rowKey`
(e.g. `record => record.id`); the default index-based fallback key is
only unique *within the current dataset order*, so it survives simple
pagination but not a re-sort or a data mutation, the same inherent
limitation `rowKey`'s own index-based fallback already has elsewhere.

defaultSelectedKeys.description: Initial selected keys when uncontrolled (`selectedKeys` omitted).

onSelectionChange.description: Called whenever selection changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

renderBulkActions.description:
Renders the action buttons in the bulk-action `<Toolbar>` that appears
once at least one row is selected — the selection-count label is
already provided; this renders only the actions themselves (e.g.
"Delete", "Export"), receiving the current selection to act on.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for density, border style, and striping.

components.description: Virtualized, sortable, paginated data table with sticky headers

components.name: EmptyState
components.constraints: Only `<EmptyState.Title>` is expected — Icon/Description/Action are all optional
components.description: Slot-based placeholder for an empty list/search/error state — same compositional pattern as `<Card>`

components.name: Filmstrip

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of thumbnail definitions to render.

activeId.description: Controlled active item id. Omit to let `<Filmstrip>` manage its own state internally.

onChange.description: Change callback fired whenever the active item changes, controlled or not.

overrides.description:
Per-instance overrides for the active-item indicator. Reuses
`<TabStrip>`'s own registered `ThemeSlice` (its active-indicator
tokens — `variant`/`size` are ignored here) rather than a second,
parallel slice, so a filmstrip's active-thumbnail ring always matches
the app's tab styling.

components.description: Horizontally-scrollable thumbnail strip with an active-item indicator, reusing TabStrip's own overflow scroll detection

components.name: Gallery

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting (forwarded to the internal `<Viewer>`). Auto-generated if omitted.

columns.description:
Number of columns, or `'auto-fit'`/`'auto-fill'` for responsive
behaviour — passed straight through to `<Grid>`'s own prop.

onItemClick.description:
Custom click handler, called instead of the default "open in
`<Viewer>`" behaviour. Use this to host `<ViewerContent>` in a
`<Drawer>`/`<Popup>`/anywhere else of your own choosing — `<Gallery>`
itself doesn't need to know or care which shell you pick.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for thumbnail aspect ratio.

components.description: Thumbnail grid with lazy-rendered items, opening a fullscreen Viewer by default

components.name: Heatmap

values.description: Cell values, indexed `[rowIndex][columnIndex]`, same order as `rows`/`columns`.

height.description: SVG height in pixels, including the axis band.

formatValue.description: Formats a cell's value for its tooltip/accessible label.

components.description: Row/column magnitude grid with a theme-tracking sequential ramp

components.name: LineChart

categories.description: X-axis category labels, one per data position.

series.description: One or more series, each with one value per `categories` entry. A single series renders one line and no legend.

height.description: SVG height in pixels, including the axis band.

title.description: Accessible name for the chart, and its visible caption when given.

variant.description: `'line'` (default) draws unfilled lines. `'area'` fills a soft wash (~10% opacity) under each line's band-edge; with 2+ series the bands stack (cumulative), matching the toolkit's dataviz method for part-to-whole-over-time.

legendPosition.description: `'bottom'` (default) wraps the legend below the chart; `'side'` places it beside the chart, stacked vertically.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the chart's gridline visibility.

components.description: Multi-series line chart with a shared hover crosshair; `variant="area"` renders a stacked, filled area chart

components.name: PieChart

data.description: Slices to render. More than 8 are folded: the largest 7 keep their own slice, the rest merge into "Other" — a chart never generates a 9th categorical hue (see `chartColors.ts`).

width.description: SVG width and height in pixels — pie charts render square, so only the smaller of the two is used.

innerRadius.description: Fraction of the outer radius left as a hole, for a donut. `0` (default) renders a full pie.

legendPosition.description: `'bottom'` (default) wraps the legend below the ring; `'side'` places it beside the ring, stacked vertically — the more common layout for a donut.

components.description: Part-to-whole pie or donut chart

components.name: Progress

id.description: Unique identifier included in emitted `progress:changed` events.

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the track's corner shape.

components.description: Determinate progress bar

components.name: ScaleLegend

min.description: Value at the light end of the ramp.

max.description: Value at the dark end of the ramp.

components.description: Gradient legend for a sequential (magnitude) color-encoded chart

components.name: Skeleton

shape.description:
Shape primitive.
- `'text'` — A single line of text, rounded, `1em`-ish tall.
- `'circle'` — A circle (avatar-shaped placeholder).
- `'rect'` — A rectangle with mild corner rounding (image/card placeholder).

components.description: Shimmering loading placeholder in text/circle/rect shapes

components.name: Sparkline

values.description: Sequential values forming the trend line, oldest first.

components.description: Minimal inline trend line for a stat tile

components.name: Spinner

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted, then the theme's primary colour.

components.description: Indeterminate circular loading indicator, same subtheme colouring as `<Progress>`

components.name: Stepper

id.description: Unique identifier for `stepper:changed` event bus payloads. Auto-generated if omitted.

defaultActiveIndex.description: Initial active step index when uncontrolled.

onActiveIndexChange.description: Called whenever the active step changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

components.constraints: Forward navigation past a step with `formId` set is blocked until that step's `<Form>` reports `isValid: true`
components.description: Linear step wizard built on the same Radix Tabs primitive as `<TabStrip>`, with per-step Form validation gating

components.name: TabStrip

groupId.description:
The `id` of the `<TabStrip>` group this panel belongs to — must match
that TabStrip's own `id` exactly. This is the *only* link between them;
they don't need to share a DOM ancestor. Rendering this panel without
its matching TabStrip mounted anywhere is valid — it just never
receives a `tab:changed` event, so it stays hidden.

value.description: The tab id (matching one of that TabStrip's `items`) this panel renders for.

id.description:
Identifies this tab group for event bus coordination — every
`<TabStrip.Panel groupId={...}>` that should respond to this control
must use the exact same string. Required (not auto-generated) because,
unlike a Modal's `id`, it has to be a stable value the panels — wherever
they're rendered — can reference independently.

items.description: Array of tab definitions to render.

activeId.description:
Controlled active tab id. Omit to let `<TabStrip>` manage its own
state internally — the common case, since panels never need it passed
down (they get it from the bus).

onChange.description:
Change callback for controlled usage (e.g. syncing with a router).
Cross-tree panels should not rely on this — they subscribe to
`tab:changed` via `useAIEvent` instead, which fires regardless of
whether this component is controlled or self-managed.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for variant, size, active-tab colour, and panel transition.

components.description: Scrollable tab header with filmstrip overflow. Use TabStrip.Panel for content

components.name: Tree

id.description: Unique identifier for `tree:expanded`/`tree:collapsed` event bus payloads. Auto-generated if omitted.

expandedIds.description: Controlled set of expanded node ids. Pass to drive expansion from parent state instead of managing it internally.

defaultExpandedIds.description: Initial expanded ids when uncontrolled (`expandedIds` omitted).

onExpandedChange.description: Called whenever a node expands or collapses, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

selectedId.description: Controlled selected node id. Pass to drive selection from parent state instead of managing it internally.

defaultSelectedId.description: Initial selected id when uncontrolled (`selectedId` omitted).

onSelectChange.description: Called whenever selection changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for indent and row spacing.

components.constraints: Rendered as a flat, single-level DOM list with `aria-level`/`aria-setsize`/`aria-posinset` conveying hierarchy (not nested `role="group"` elements) — a WAI-ARIA-APG-accepted alternative that keeps each visible row independently wrappable in `<DeferredContent>` for large trees
components.description: Data-driven tree view with expand/collapse, single selection, and full WAI-ARIA Treeview keyboard navigation

value.description: Unique string key identifying this item (used for expand/collapse tracking).

title.description: Content rendered in the clickable header trigger.

content.description: Content rendered in the collapsible body panel.

disabled.description: If true, the item cannot be expanded or collapsed.

content.description: Slide content — any renderable element (an image, a card, arbitrary markup).

label.description: Series identity — the legend swatch label and tooltip row label.

values.description: One value per entry in the chart's `categories` array, same order.

key.description:
Property key on the data record to read the cell value from, and
this column's identifier for sorting/React-key purposes. Typed
against `T` — with a plain-string fallback preserved so this isn't a
breaking change for existing callers — so an editor/AI agent gets
real autocomplete instead of guessing a property name. Still
required when `accessorFn` is given, as this column's stable id;
pick any string in that case, since the value itself comes from
`accessorFn` instead.

accessorFn.description:
Computed cell value for a column that isn't a direct property read
(a concatenation, a derived/formatted field). Receives the full
record and takes precedence over `record[key]` when given — this
column also participates in sorting through it.

render.description: Custom cell renderer. Receives this cell's value/row/index as a single object.

sortable.description: If true, clicking this column header toggles sorting.

width.description: Column width as CSS value (e.g. `'12rem'`) or number (px).

id.description: Unique identifier for this item — used in `activeId` and `onChange`.

content.description: Thumbnail content rendered in the strip, e.g. an ``.

label.description: Accessible label for this item, e.g. `"Photo 3 of 12"`.

disabled.description: If true, the item cannot be selected.

thumbnailSrc.description: Thumbnail image source shown in the grid.

fullSrc.description: Full-resolution image source opened in the `<Viewer>` (or passed to `onItemClick`).

alt.description: Alt text, used for both the thumbnail and the full-resolution image.

caption.description: Optional caption shown in the `<Viewer>` for this item.

label.description: Label rendered next to this step's number/checkmark indicator.

formId.description:
If given, forward navigation past this step is blocked until a
`<Form id={formId}>` somewhere in `content` reports `isValid: true`
over the event bus (`form:validated`). Omit for a step with no form to
gate on (e.g. a pure informational/review step).

disabled.description: If true, this step can never be navigated to directly (still counts toward the linear sequence).

id.description: Unique identifier for this tab — used in `activeId` and `onChange`.

label.description: Label content rendered in the tab header.

icon.description: Optional icon rendered before the label.

disabled.description: If true, the tab cannot be selected.

id.description: Unique string key identifying this node.

label.description: Content rendered for this node's row.

disabled.description: If true, this node cannot be expanded, collapsed, or selected.
